reply: h terms. The time shape is best matched by tanh among the saturating forms I tested. Even the broadest basis I tried (monomials in P and t, each with and without tanh) stalls at about 2e-7 NMSE, not 1e-12. So the structure is still missing something, and I would not trust these constants as the law.

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    G = np.tanh(params[9]*t)
    return (params[0]*G + params[1]*P*t + params[2]*P**2 + params[3]*P**3*G
            + params[4]*P + params[5]*t + params[6]*t*P**2 + params[7]*P**3*t + params[8]*P*G)
